notes: Generic read-time advisories (X0 S10b). Correction-specific advisories live on the corrections in corrections/<pkg>.json; this file holds the advisories that are not tied to one correction.

applies_to is one of the predicates implemented in gridform_core/result_advisories.py: pre_profile_run (the run recorded no methodology profile), legacy_validation_report (the run's scientific-validation report is not the recomputed v2 schema, e.g. the v1 self-reported report), fleet_assets (A24-2: the run's frozen fleet contains an asset class of applies_when.assets_any, the classes of market_replay.canonical_technology; a fleet that cannot be read keeps the advisory). fleet_assets rows disclose a limitation of every profile; they are presentation only and never part of the method identity.
Severity high or critical puts every comparison that includes the run into attribution_status needs_review (no causal conclusion).

advisories.title: Produced before the 2026-10 review fixes
advisories.summary: This Run was produced by a VALUE version before methodology profiles and the 2026-10-04 review corrections. Known issues may affect its energy balance, validation status and annual results; its recorded validation status is superseded.

advisories.title: Validation report not independently verified
advisories.summary: This run's scientific-validation report is not the recomputed v2 report (for example the v1 report, which relies on the model's self-reported, compatibility-adjusted residuals); its passed statements were not recomputed from the ledger by the independent energy-balance check.

advisories.title: Biomass without support revenue
advisories.summary: VALUE does not model CfD or ROC support revenue for biomass (review finding P4-07, planned for the next round). Biomass therefore offers at its full fuel and carbon cost (85 GBP/MWh in the shipped GB parameters, above CCGT 55.07 and OCGT 74.92) and is rarely dispatched (GBP1 and R029 2025: about 0.01 TWh from 4,762 MW). Read the generation mix, emissions, prices and the biomass investment account with this in mind; both methodology profiles behave this way.
